_note: Refined in Session 2 — expanded from 6 to 12 questions with detailed YES/NO branches and cash/transport tiers
title: Emergency Independence — Kicked Out (Session 2 Refined)

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: I'm sorry that happened. You don't have to tell me why, but I need to know: Are you in physical danger right now?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Physical safety overrides everything. If in danger, coaching stops and crisis resources deploy immediately.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text:
You matter. Please reach out to one of these right now. I'll wait.
- 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline
- National Safeline: 1-800-799-7233
- Youth Shelter Finder

Reply 'done' when you've contacted one.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Are you with someone you trust right now?
nodes.why_alex_asks: A trusted person nearby changes the immediate risk profile. If alone and in danger, urgency increases. Added in Session 2.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Do you have a safe place to sleep tonight?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Tonight's shelter is the most immediate practical need after safety.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text:
Let's find one. Use Youth Shelter Finder below, or reply with your city.

If you have a car: 24hr Walmart or truck stop parking lots.
If you don't: 24hr diners, hospital waiting rooms, library lobbies if open.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Are you under 18?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Minors have different legal protections and mandatory reporting requirements. Coaching path changes significantly for minors.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text:
Because you're a minor, in some states I'm required to report this. I want to help you do this safely.

Let's find a trusted adult — teacher, counselor, relative, or friend's parent. You can also contact:
- National Runaway Safeline: 1-800-RUNAWAY
- Your school counselor

Say 'ready' when you want to continue the plan.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Do you have any form of ID with you? (Driver's license, passport, birth certificate, school ID, social security card)
nodes.why_alex_asks: Without ID, nearly every service (SNAP, Medicaid, jobs, bank accounts, housing) is inaccessible. Replacing ID is the #1 Day 1 priority.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text:
That's okay, we can replace them. This is your top priority for Day 1.

1. Replace birth certificate (state vital records)
2. Get state ID card (DMV — cheaper than license)
3. Replace SS card (ssa.gov — free)

Reply with your state and I'll give you exact links.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Is your phone working with service?
nodes.why_alex_asks: A working phone is the lifeline — job applications, benefit applications, shelter calls, navigation. Added in Session 2.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: How much money do you have right now?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Determines immediate survival window. $0 = same-day cash priority. $100+ = focus on stabilization.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: What transportation do you have?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Transportation dictates which jobs, shelters, and services are accessible. Car = gig apps. None = remote-only.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Are you currently working?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Determines whether to deploy employment path or simply stabilize existing income.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Do you have a bank account?
nodes.why_alex_asks: A bank account is required for direct deposit, benefit payments, and financial independence.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: What city are you in? (I never save your exact address — just city and state so I can give you local resources.)
nodes.why_alex_asks: All resources are location-dependent. Added in Session 2. Alex never stores exact addresses.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: What's your education level?
nodes.why_alex_asks: Shapes employment path. No diploma = Job Corps priority. Some college = better temp placement.

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Here's your 72-hour stabilization plan. Your only job is survival. Check off each item as you go.

tasks.task: Replace at least one form of ID
Get a mailing address (P.O. Box or General Delivery)

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Once you're stable, let's get income coming in. Pick the lane that fits:

tasks.task: Gig apps — DoorDash, Instacart, TaskRabbit — start earning in 24-48h
Online gigs — Uber Eats bike, Rover, Fiverr, UserTesting
Temp agency — Robert Half, Express Employment — same-week start

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: Housing is a ladder. Here are your options from fastest to most stable:

tasks.task: Own rental — requires income, deposit, credit

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text: You've done the hard part — you're stable and moving forward. Here's what's available free vs. premium:

premium_features.label: Family mediation script
premium_features.description: Exactly what to say to negotiate with parents/family

premium_features.label: Weekly 1:1 check-in
premium_features.description: Personal coach, emotional check, progress review

nodes.speaker: alex
nodes.text:
You're on your way. Life Map saved. Weekly check-ins enabled.

Getting kicked out is not your fault. You didn't fail. We'll get through this one checkbox at a time.

Reply 'check-in' anytime.
